current.text: He is expected to be an energy player off the bench for about 18 minutes, behind Maxime Raynaud.
Domantas Sabonis is the projected starting center for the Kings.
A Sabonis trade is still possible.
With Yahoo value of 0 USD and a Yahoo rank of 197, he is not a draft target in a 144 player league. He is a waiver option only.

durable.text: He is a defensive-minded energy big. His value comes from rebounds and blocks.
He makes no threes and scores very little.
He is a poor free throw shooter. He shot 40% from the line in Summer League. He takes about one free throw per game, so the damage to team FT% is limited.
He shoots a high FG% on low volume and commits few turnovers.
